That one is for a doctor, not a coach. At 15 you're still growing, and whether creatine or any supplement makes sense for you is a call for your doctor or a registered dietitian, ideally with a parent in the loop. I won't give you an amount either way.

What I can tell you is that most of the progress at your age comes from the basics: consistent training, enough food (protein included), and good sleep. Want me to build you a program or a session so we can get those working for you?
